promoteGhostDialog.title: Create a change?
promoteGhostDialog.body: The exploration {{name}} will be turned into a change and added to the Ready column.
promoteGhostDialog.bodyDetail: The Fast-Forward agent will generate the artifacts (proposal, design, specs, tasks) from the exploration's context.

deleteGhostDialog.title: Abandon this exploration?
deleteGhostDialog.body: The conversation will be lost. This action is irreversible.

unlaunchWorkerDialog.title: Interrupt worker and demote?
unlaunchWorkerDialog.body: An Agent Pool worker is currently running on change {{name}}.
unlaunchWorkerDialog.bodyDetail: The worker will be stopped and the task moved back to the Ready column. Changes and commits in the worktree will be preserved.

errors.unlaunchWorkerActive: Cannot demote: an Agent Pool worker is active on this change.

card.workerActiveTooltip: An Agent Pool worker is currently assigned to this change
card.stopWorkerTooltip: Interrupt worker and demote to Ready
